line: On New Year's Eve the beast Nian comes to town, and one girl's giant paper-cut lights up the village to scare it off.
line_cn: 除夕年兽进村，小女孩剪出的大窗花照亮全村，把它吓跑。

camera.move: Extreme close-up tracking the scissor tip
camera.serves: a beginning of work; a precise act; a signature
a title; a statement; a family portrait
a village, a route, a timeline

camera.move: Low wide, a shape standing up from the ground layer
camera.serves: a storm; a rival; a deadline arriving

camera.move: Push toward a lit piece, pull back to many

camera.serves: day to night; before and after; chapters

camera.move: Pull back to an object in a room
camera.expresses: the film was a thing someone made

transitions: Transitions are paper actions (fold, page turn, peel, a sheet flying off, a cut through the frame);
labels: Subtitles are a paper strip in the world, e.g. a red banner (横批) darker than the picture's reds so cream text holds, serrated edges, swallow-tail ends; a sturdy OFL serif (e.g. Fraunces SemiBold) around 44 px, low, with a paper shadow. It drops in on two 12 fps steps, like a couplet being pasted. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.7 s); never overlap.
Titles are cut-out letters (yang-cut, counters are real holes) popping in letter by letter on 12 fps steps, with sawtooth border strips and a seal cut by code.
Small credits may be printed ink on paper.
motion: Characters step at 12 fps (pose sampled at floor(t·12)/12); camera, light, weather, flames and flying pieces move on ones at 24 fps.
Rigs pin pieces at rivets (neck, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, jaws, tails). Hard poses, tiny eases, 1-frame overshoots ("pop" = 1.15× for one step). Weight comes from size and camera shake.
In profile, a raised near arm crosses the face: keep hands forward of the face or let a prop cover them.

Folding: the flap is split into ~16 strips; each is compressed by cosθ and enlarged along the fold by 1 + 0.28·height (fake perspective), darkened as it stands up, in a lighter back colour past 90°, with a growing shadow and a crease after. About half a second per fold, each on a hit.

native_moves.name: Fold – cut – unfold
native_moves.does: Fold a sheet 2/4/8 times; one cut becomes many. Put the unfold on a strong beat.
native_moves.fits: one teacher, many students; a single design mass-produced; one seed becoming a field.

native_moves.name: Holes are light
native_moves.does: A cut-out lit from behind glows deep red, every hole glows, and the pattern is projected onto the world.
native_moves.fits: an idea shining through a person; a lighthouse; a window at night in a story about home.

native_moves.name: Symmetry replicates
native_moves.does: A mirrored motif peels off and multiplies (rosette → window flowers → fireworks).
native_moves.fits: a franchise; cell division; a song spreading through a crowd.

native_moves.name: Scraps have a future
native_moves.does: The bits that fall while cutting come back later (as snow, confetti, stars).
native_moves.fits: recycling; leftover time; small failures that add up.

native_moves.name: Everything is one flat sheet
native_moves.does: Things share the same cuts, so a ridge can stand up and be a creature, or a wave become a road.
native_moves.fits: a landscape that becomes a map; a factory that turns out to be one machine; a zoom out to the made object.

native_moves.name: Mirrored pair
native_moves.does: Two figures cut from one folded sheet.
native_moves.fits: twins; a partnership; before/after of the same person.

score.note: bright Chinese chamber ensemble: pipa, zheng, erhu, dizi
